name: code-review-gate
description: Review-then-gate: an agent prepares the change, a human approval gate holds the risky step until you decide.

config.prompt: Prepare the change and summarize exactly what the deploy step will run.

task_template:
Prepare this change: {change}
Hold any shell execution for approval.

inputs.name: change
inputs.label: change to prepare
inputs.placeholder: bump the version and tag a release
